requirement_zh: 所有交付帶固定候選ID、用途、版本、來源與unknown；不用新ID藏用途修訂
requirement_en: Preserve fixed IDs and version purpose revisions; retain unknowns.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Exact joins use Mars ID + Earth ID + purpose version; no old ranking imports
change_trigger: ID or purpose mismatch pauses integration

requirement_zh: 界定UV實際plot/radius、座標datum與精度；W只是錨點
requirement_en: Define the actual W-vicinity footprint and coordinate reference.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Do not infer a drill footprint from printed station coordinates
evidence_locator: Team1 report sections1,4; Team2 Earth followup
requested_deliverable: Footprint GeoJSON or explicit bounds with CRS and provenance
change_trigger: No footprint: historical reference only

requirement_zh: 提供同測區、同位置與時期可用的獨立冰界面真值；歷史42cm不是新真值
requirement_en: Provide independent interface truth with spatial and temporal linkage.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Keep inference inputs separate from held-out truth; flag historical vs current
requested_deliverable: Truth records with location depth date and independent method
change_trigger: No independent truth: no blind accuracy claim

requirement_zh: 量測覆土材質厚度與熱響應；地面探針不等同TES
requirement_en: Measure overburden and thermal response without assuming TES equivalence.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Declare measured quantity units method footprint and confounders; no TI equivalence by assumption
change_trigger: Unidentifiable controls: descriptive scope only

requirement_zh: 預先定義盲判、真值留出及誤差評估；若報誤判率需有冰與無冰真值
requirement_en: Specify blinded evaluation and independent controls.
observable_or_quantity: depth error; bias; false positive and negative rates
acceptance_or_qa_rule: No reuse of public42cm as both fitted answer and held-out truth; no rates without labeled controls
change_trigger: No holdout: protocol proposal only

requirement_zh: 分開火星區域單元與地球測站/剖面；補局部地形、風險與尺度對應
requirement_en: Separate regional support from experimental-plot terrain.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: No 100km historical Earth ranking as I01/I02 match; no low-slope safety inference
evidence_locator: Ice Candidate QA!J2:K3; Team1 terrain gap
change_trigger: Unsupported spatial comparison is removed

requirement_zh: 說明現地環境與可模擬限制；不配對不同定義的沙塵光學厚度
requirement_en: Document environmental limits and incompatible dust quantities.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Earth550nm extinction and Mars9.3um absorption stay separate; reanalysis is not station weather
change_trigger: No transfer model: no Mars performance claim

requirement_zh: 已收到Team1接受UV已知用途對照；請回覆主線v1可行性與protocol對照
requirement_en: Acknowledge mainline v1 feasibility after accepting UV as a known-use reference.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Preserve EARTH-UV-001; I02 remains pending until formal evidence and ID
change_trigger: Known-use overlap requires revised claim or documented selection change

requirement_zh: EARTH-002已收到；請對照主線v1補新試驗範圍、獨立真值與可行控制，不另湊新地點
requirement_en: Review the received EARTH-002 handoff against mainline v1 and fill footprint/truth gaps.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Preserve EARTH-UV-001; I02 remains pending until formal evidence and ID
evidence_locator: Team1 TEAM1-ICE-REDO-v1 main cf72039 CSV row3
requested_deliverable: Version crosswalk; station-versus-plot and independent-truth plan
change_trigger: No protocol/truth: descriptive archived-data study only

requirement_zh: 同方法下取得高低熱背景或不同覆土對照；有條件再做冰損失附屬模組
requirement_en: Add compatible thermal contrasts; enable ice-loss work only with full measurements.
observable_or_quantity: initial/final ice mass; sample temperature; handling time
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Mass loss needs ice-specific mass balance and handling controls; bit temperature is not sample integrity
requested_deliverable: Optional module feasibility and required measurements
change_trigger: Missing measurements: omit ice-loss outcome

requirement_zh: 依v1問題比較既有研究的控制、反應量、真值、足跡及讀取範圍
requirement_en: Audit the revised question and controls rather than only site names.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Separate known method, exact footprint, complete protocol, and proposed contribution
change_trigger: Same question and controls already solved: withdraw originality

requirement_zh: 收到UV範圍後比對實際舊孔與protocol；2.13km中心差不代替交集
requirement_en: Check actual footprints once the W-vicinity extent is defined.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Do not transfer W42cm to2010 drill; no full-paper claim if only abstract read
change_trigger: Exact same-use hit updates scoped result

requirement_zh: 續查Mars替代EZ/資源ROI與完整清單；保留每個已排除範圍的適用界線
requirement_en: Complete outstanding proposal-extent checks with explicit scope.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: P1/P2/P3 nonoverlap is not complete clearance; P4/P5 remain unresolved
requested_deliverable: Per-candidate inspected and unchecked footprint matrix
change_trigger: Same-footprint same-use proposal changes novelty statement

requirement_zh: 提供原始來源manifest與重採樣鏈，區分觀測日、產品日與下載日
requirement_en: Deliver source manifest and processing lineage.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Include hash units CRS nodata scale offset acquisition and creation times; no reranking or weights change
change_trigger: Wrong product or footprint pauses affected comparison

requirement_zh: 沿用原MOLA坡度與高差方法，保留基線及有效格；不以公里平均推安全
requirement_en: Preserve regional MOLA methods and validity counts.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Audit source support; no recalibrated score or boulder-scale safety claim
requested_deliverable: Native support/QA extract with method references
change_trigger: Invalid terrain support pauses terrain use

requirement_zh: TES分開含/不含插補摘要與遮罩；提供誤差資訊可用性
requirement_en: Report TES validity and interpolation treatment separately.
observable_or_quantity: TI; mask; missing and infilled counts
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Exclude mask0 in adopted summary; grid scatter is not measurement uncertainty; no strength inference
requested_deliverable: TES statistics and available uncertainty metadata
change_trigger: Coverage or uncertainty gap narrows interpretation

requirement_zh: 保留SWIM原始指標、分量支援與鄰區插值；缺測不得補零
requirement_en: Retain SWIM consistency, component support and interpolation weights.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Do not convert to ice fraction depth probability; depth maps share inputs; native vs interpolated order reversal retained
change_trigger: Invalid support pauses comparison; qualified contrary ice evidence must specify footprint depth time and detection limits; H1/H2 null results do not imply no ice

requirement_zh: 盤點兩火星候選可用日夜/季節溫度；無合格資料保留null
requirement_en: Inventory candidate-specific temperature without borrowing reference-region values.
observable_or_quantity: surface temperature; brightness or air temperature separately
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Record local time season footprint quantity and QA; TI never fills temperature
change_trigger: No qualified series: no thermal-equivalence or extremes claim

requirement_zh: 交UV24月MODIS抽取與完整QC明細，不用唯一夜值算平均或日夜差
requirement_en: Audit the supplied MODIS extraction and missingness.
observable_or_quantity: LST day/night; QC; valid month count
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Verify raw nodata scale0.02 QC policy footprint; day0/24 night1/24 under supplied strict rule cannot support annual means or contrast
requested_deliverable: Per-file hashes raw/scaled values QA reasons and valid counts
change_trigger: Insufficient QA retains null summary

requirement_zh: 交MERRA2原檔抽取、遮罩與月天數加權；U/V與沙塵定義分開
requirement_en: Audit MERRA2 background and quantity definitions.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Nearest coarse grid is not W station; components are not mean wind speed; no cross-wavelength dust subtraction
requested_deliverable: Per-file provenance coordinates units and weighting checks
change_trigger: Quantity mismatch removes comparison

requirement_zh: 若可取得現地資料，保留站點/深度/時間/校準與真值用途；先報可用性
requirement_en: Preserve site-depth-time and calibration for field data.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Do not infer current ice from historical station record; declare train/holdout and detection limits
change_trigger: No independent truth: no accuracy result

requirement_zh: 設備與資料未定之前，不設合格誤差、樣本量、覆蓋率或能耗門檻
requirement_en: Keep acceptance thresholds undefined until the measurement task is specified.
observable_or_quantity: error; count; coverage; thermal tolerance; energy
acceptance_or_qa_rule: threshold_value stays empty; threshold_status=not_defined; never replace unknown with zero
requested_deliverable: Rationale for any future threshold revision
change_trigger: Undefined thresholds prohibit suitability/pass claims

requirement_zh: 組別缺候選/QA/用途查核任一項，整合狀態維持未完成
requirement_en: Require pairing, numerical QA and scoped prior-work review before a completed claim.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: No first/new/validated analog claim; D03/D04 context only; no old Earth ranking restore
change_trigger: New evidence changes scope with dated revision

requirement_zh: 完整季節資料、局部雷達/取芯互證與環境艙可協助；若外推火星性能則轉為必要
requirement_en: Add seasonal and independent observations; validate transfer before Mars performance claims.
observable_or_quantity: seasonal response; independent geometry; transfer model
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Optional for proposal design; required if claiming Mars equipment or sublimation performance
change_trigger: No transfer validation limits output to Earth reference

requirement_zh: 先接Team1 GPU-EARTH-002-01，恢復108頁EH2表並保留頁列與兩時標、raw/corrected RH
requirement_en: Recover EH2 hourly records before derived analysis.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Verify supplement hash20fe70f574bc394f05f0c720809f80a9602ac73f6ede34d322ea816cf25590d9; page headers duplicates gaps; preserve GMT-07:00 and GMT-5:30 until resolved; no silent RH clipping
requested_deliverable: Tidy table source page/row dictionary parser command QA exceptions
change_trigger: Unresolved time/parse issues block time-aligned derived outputs

requirement_zh: GPU-09 QA後接Team1 GPU-EARTH-002-02，只算共同有效夏季深度熱差與覆蓋率
requirement_en: Describe paired-depth summer response after EH2 QA.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Window2017-12-01 to2018-02-28;3cm is subsurface;3cm stops2018-03-18;retrieval2018-12-04 is not guaranteed last valid row; no winter infill annual3cm ice-depth or TI inversion
requested_deliverable: Paired-depth plots coverage counts quantiles and TableII comparison using identical windows
change_trigger: No paired valid support: null summary, no inferred boundary or performance

requirement_zh: 查EARTH-002精確用途與v1控制；EH3已有UV–EH比較，不把兩站比較稱新貢獻
requirement_en: Audit EARTH-002 methods and revised controls against known EH studies.
acceptance_or_qa_rule: Use fixed station anchor only; inspect scope of EH1/EH3/EH4 and full-protocol sources; mark unread texts; compare controls/truth/outcomes not names
evidence_locator: Team1 sections8-9; main cf72039 CSV row3
change_trigger: Existing same controls/outcomes removes novelty claim; no automatic reselection
